a:r.a:t: The Transcription of Many Genes Is Controlled by Many Different Factors

p:cNvPr.descr: A diagram of the PEP carboxykinase promoter region. The diagram begins on the left with DNA at the beginning of two horizontal blue lines that extend throughout the diagram. In the first section of the blue lines is dAF2. Above that is a tan oval FOXO1. Next in the DNA line is dAF1. Above that is a red vertical oval representing PPAR gamma2 and a purple rectangle representing HNF-3 beta. There is a split in the DNA. It continues after the split with SRE in pink, and large green X above it, representing SREBP-1. To the right of that in the DNA line is AF1 in a green box, with HNF-4 alpha COUP-TF RAR above it. To the right of that is a white box with AF2 in it. It has a purple rectangle representing HNF-3 beta, and a tan oval FOXO1. To the right of that in the DNA box is GRE in an oragne box, with a purple rectangle with a green square inside, representing GR. A small plain white rectangle comes next in the DNA line. Next to that to the right is a light green box with TRE. Above that is a gray oval on top of a light green rectangle, representing T3R. To the right of that on the DNA line is a pink box with SRE inside and a green X on top, representing SREBP-1. To the right of that in the DNA line is a blue box with P4 and a purple box to the right of that with P3II. Above those two boxes is a blue half-moon on the left and a purple half-moon on the right, representing fos/jun. To the right of that in the DNA line is P3I with a large red X above it, representing C/EBP. To the right of that is a white box with P2 inside and gray vertical oval above it, representing HNF-1. To the right of that is a light blue box with P1, which has a purple box with a green box inside above, representing NF1. Next comes CRE in a yellow box on the DNA line. This box has the two half-moons representing fos/jun, a hexagon with a green square in the middle representing ATF3, two orange wavy rectangles representing CREB, and a large red X representing C/EBP. To the right of that is a darker blue box with TATA. Above that is a green oval, representing NF kappa B. After that is plus 1, then the blue DNA lines shot down right, then go up to the right. There is a larger oval representing the mediator that runs through the TATA and plus 1 boxes. Below those boxes is a tan oval with TBP inside. A green line runs through the DNA lines on the far right, representing mRNA. A tan half moons wraps around the DNA lines that dropped right and up. This represents Pol II. Below that is another lighter tan half moon representing TFIIH. Directly below the DNA boxes at dAF2 is -1500. Between the SRE and P4 boxes, below the DNA line is -300. Below the image is a legend of transcription factors, as follows: FOXO1 is forkhead box other 1; PPAR gamma2 is peroxisome proliferator-activated receptor gamma2; HNF-3 beta is hepatic nuclear factor-3 beta; SREBP-1 is sterol regulatory element binding protein-1; HNF-4 alpha is hepatic nuclear factor-4 alpha; COUP-TF is chicken ovalbumin upstream promoter-transcription factor; RAR is reinoic acid receptor; C/EBP is CAAT/enhance binding protein; HNF-1 is hepatic nuclear factor-1; NF1 is nuclear factor 1; ATF3 is activating transcription factor 3; CREB is CAMP response element binding protein; NF kappa B is nuclear factor kappa B; TBP is TATA=box binding protein; and TFIIH is transcription factor IIH. To the right of that is another legend for response elements and regulatory binding sites in promoter. They include: dAF2, which is distal accessory factor 2; dAF1, which is distal accessory factor 1; SRE, which is sterol regulatory element; AF1, which is accessory factor 1; AF2, which is accessory factor 2; GRE, which is glucocorticoid regulatory element; TRE, which is thyroid hormone regulatory element; and CRE, which is cAMP regulatory element.
